children: Japanese stocks are higher after Nvidia's robust quarterly results ease fears about the artificial-intelligence trade that was rocked by the scandal surrounding the chip maker's CEO. The market is also supported by hopes a successful initial public offering by Anthropic. Chip and AI-related stocks are leading gains. SoftBank Group is up 6.8% and Kioxia Holdings is 5.1% higher. The dollar is at 159.49 yen, compared with Y159.27 as of Tuesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching developments in the Middle East and their implications for energy prices. The Nikkei Stock Average is up 1.0% at 59425.40. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
